scientific_integrity: Proved pairwise majorization and unit-increment greedy lemmas; exhaustive finite tests are supplementary. No independent audit or external proof certification.
scientific_limitations: Requires common normalized additive valuations and positive two-denomination goods with an integer ratio. The sharp converse is about the displayed two-stage procedure; does not exclude other optima at noninteger ratios. Existing general NSW and leximin algorithms may provide implicit related facts.
title: Universal Lorenz balance for unit-divisible two-size goods, with a sharp divisibility boundary
